reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's V4 (LOSO Ridge residual learner on V3 Linear-ST predictions with per-segment yaw bias), fitting per-platform Cα via multistart L-BFGS-B and pooling LOSO across all 545 Ford segments.
notes: Reconstructed V4 by re-running the agent's pipeline: per-platform Linear-ST with multistart-fit Cα (V3) plus per-segment yaw-gyro bias on straights, then a pooled LOSO Ridge residual learner across all 545 Ford segments. Final pred = pred_v3_adj - oof_residual. Cα was fit per platform since agent's reported coefficients were Mach-E only; bias and residual learner pipeline mirror agent's V4.
